summary: Amass Brands Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement to update its existing resale registration covering up to 14,293,298 shares held by registered stockholders, linked to its direct listing on Nasdaq. The supplement incorporates recent Form 10-Q and 8-K filings and includes risk factors but no new securities offering or special-situation transaction. This is a routine shelf/resale prospectus update, not an acquisition, divestiture, tender, spin-off, or strategic action. Investors should monitor the ongoing resale overhang and any future amendments, but this filing itself does not constitute a special situation.
